title: BRAD-Edu: a semi-synthetic Arabic educational corpus for affect-aware recommendation
description: BRAD-Edu extends the BRAD corpus of Arabic book reviews into a test bed for educational recommender systems: 456,264 real opinions by 72,379 readers on 4,993 books (disjoint from LABR), with reader histories, extended with resource difficulty, learner ability, success, score, time on task, completion and frustration generated by a declared model (seed 2026). Review texts are not redistributed; a generator rebuilds the full corpus from the original BRAD file.
